highlights: New Streak Freeze: protect your streak once a month by using it on today before the day closes
Badges and personal bests now pop a celebration banner the moment you earn them
New Weekly Recap panel: your last 7 days at a glance
Playbook sections are now collapsible — tap a heading to expand it
New Achievements panel: streaks, personal bests, and badges (Iron Stomach, Marathoner, Century Club, Honor Roll, Redemption Arc, Weekend Warrior)
Admin dashboard's rules button is now labeled "Playbook"
Update notifications can now show what's new before reloading
